Project: ACCESS TO CLEAN RESILIENT ELECTRICITY PROJECT (ACRE)

Loan No./Credit No./ Grant No.: E259-ST

Assignment Title: Hiring of a Water Technical Director for EMAE

REFERENCE NO.: 58/C/ACRE/2026

The Government of the Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe has received a grant from the International Development Association (IDA) toward the cost of the Access to Clean and Resilient Electricity Project (ACRE) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services ("the Services") include lead the implementation of measures aimed at improving the operational performance of the water utility, including reducing Non-Revenue Water (NRW), strengthening preventive and corrective maintenance, improving water quality and service reliability, enhancing asset management, and supporting improvements in commercial performance through better operational efficiency. The assignment is expected to run until December 2028, with an initial contract duration of 12 months, renewable based on satisfactory performance and project needs. The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below.

The Project Administration and Fiduciary Agency (AFAP) now invites eligible individuals ("Consultants") to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services (attach curriculum vitae with description of experience in similar assignments and similar conditions).

Candidates must hold 1) a Master's degree in a relevant field (Master’s Degree in Engineering (preferably Civil or Environmental) and; 2) must demonstrate fluency Fluency in Portuguese, English. Candidates who do not meet both requirements will not be considered.

The criteria for selecting the Consultant are:

(i) Specific experience relevant to the assignment — 40 points

  • At least 10 years of proven experience in Management Roles/Position in Water Utilities/Firms — 6.50 points
  • Experience in Organizational Transformation Processes and Management of Public Companies — 6.50 points
  • Experience in Utility Operations — 3.00 points
  • Experience in Water Tariff Analysis and experience in NRW management — 3.00 points
  • Leadership Experience — 4.00 points
  • Proven Experience in managing Public Utilities/Services characterized by high technical and commercial losses, weak collection, poor quality of service and institutional inefficiencies — 4.00 points
  • Experience and Capacity to Implement a KPI based Management approach — 3.00 points
  • Experience in the recovery/enhancement of operational efficiency, quality of service and financial performance—4.00 points
  • Experience in leading/managing technical teams through organizational and operational restructuring/reforms— 3.00 points
  • Experience working in África — 3.00 points

(ii) Qualifications and competence for the assignment — 25 points

  • MBA or other Engineering/Management Post-Graduation — 5.00 points
  • Advanced Knowledge of the Water Sector (from an operations and technical efficiency perspective) — 4.00 points
  • Knowledge and Experience with Loss Reduction Measures — 2.00 points
  • Experience in Managing and Operating Water Treatment and Distribution Systems — 2.00 points
  • KPI-based Project Management and Monitoring — 2.00 points
  • Previous positions with oversight and responsibility over Sectorial P&L — 2.00 points
  • Experience in Operations Planning and Control (experience in operational enhancement will be valuable)— 2.00 points
  • Previous experience in budgeting and financial control of utility/electricity operations— 2.00 points
  • Previous experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams— 2.00 points
  • Experience with IWA (International Water Association) performance indicators, ISO standards and utility benchmarking methodologies— 1.00 points
  • Demonstrate capacity to present, discuss and coordinate activities at a multi-disciplinary level, including with Public Institutions (ex. Commercial Directorate, AGER, DGAAC, TIU, etc.)— 1.00 points
  • Experience with private sector participation, PPPs, or performance-based contracts in the water sector will be considered an advantage.

iii) Language — 5 points

  • Fluency in English — 5 points

Total: 70 points

Following evaluation of the CVs ,of individual consultants will be subject to a competency assessment and interview, after which the best qualified candidate will be invited to contract negotiations and signing.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank's Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers ("the Regulations"), setting forth the World Bank's policy on conflict of interest.

The Chairman, Project Procurement Committee on behalf of Climate Resilience Multiphase Programmatic Approach now invites sealed Bids from eligible Bidders for Procurement of: Supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of 1 PB file storage system for the Department of Meteorology. procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

                                                                                                  (CONSULTING SERVICES)

Country: São Tomé and Principe

Project: ACCESS TO CLEAN RESILIENT ELECTRICITY PROJECT (ACRE)

Loan No./Credit No./ Grant No.: E259-ST

Assignment Title: Hiring of a Commercial Director for EMAE

REFERENCE NO.: 60/C/ACRE/2026

The Government of the Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe has received a grant from the International Development Association (IDA) toward the cost of the Access to Clean and Resilient Electricity Project (ACRE) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services ("the Services") include manage all of EMAE's commercial activity, in accordance with the Administration's strategic guidelines, activity plan, approved budget and current official legislation, coordinating and controlling the various areas of the company, being responsible for the relationship with all clients of the companies within the EMAE group, including the management of large consumers, invoicing process, management of complaints and receipts, inspections and audits, obtaining the values defined in the annual budget, namely the Gross Margin, optimizing the available human resources in a way that allows leveraging EMAE's commercial efficiency, increasing revenue, reducing commercial losses and improving customer relations. The assignment is expected to run until December 2028, with an initial contract duration of 12 months, renewable based on satisfactory performance and project needs. The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below.

The Project Administration and Fiduciary Agency (AFAP) now invites eligible individuals ("Consultants") to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services (attach curriculum vitae with description of experience in similar assignments and similar conditions).

Candidates must hold 1) Master’s Degree in Engineering (preferably Electrical) and; 2) must demonstrate fluency in Portuguese. Candidates who do not meet both requirements will not be considered.

The criteria for selecting the Consultant are:

(i) Specific experience relevant to the assignment — 40 points

  • At least 10 years of proven experience in Top Management Roles/Position — 6.50 points
  • Experience in Organizational Transformation Processes and Management of Public Companies — 6.50 points
  • Experience in Utility Operations — 3.00 points
  • Experience in Electricity and Water Tariff Analysis and Definition — 3.00 points
  • Leadership Experience — 4,00 points:
  • Proven Experience in managing Public Utilities/Services characterized by high technical and commercial losses, weak collection, poor quality of service and institutional inefficiencies — 4.00 points
  • Experience and Capacity to Implement a KPI based Management approach —3.00 points
  • Experience in Public Utilities/Services Turn-Around (Performance Recovery/Enhancement)—4.00 points
  • Experience leading Commercial Teams and Multidisciplinary Teams through Organizational and/or Operational Reform — 3.00 points
  • Experience working in África — 3.00 points

(ii) Qualifications and competence for the assignment — 25 points

  • MBA or other Engineering/Management Post-Graduation—5,00 points
  • Basic Knowledge of the Electricity Sector (from a business and management perspective) —2,00 points
  • Basic Knowledge of the Water Sector (from a business and management perspective)—2,00 points
  • Contract and Client Management —2,00 points
  • Management of Commercial Teams (especially in P-O-S environment)—3,00 points
  • Previous experience with budgeting and financial control —2,00 points
  • Previous experience in managing technical-commercial field teams —3,00 points
  • Negotiation Experience and Capacity — 2,00 points
  • Experience with Commercial Management Systems (ex: CRM, ERP, Vending Softwares, etc.)— 2,00 points
  • Demonstrate capacity to present, discuss and coordinate activities at a multi-disciplinary level, including with Public Institutions (ex. Commercial Directorate, AGER, DGRNE, TIU, etc.) — 2,00 points

(iii) Language — 5 points

  • Fluency in English — 5 points

Total: 70 points

Following evaluation of the CVs ,of individual consultants will be subject to a competency assessment and interview, after which the best qualified candidate will be invited to contract negotiations and signing.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank's Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers ("the Regulations"), setting forth the World Bank's policy on conflict of interest.

Consultants are advised to limit their Expression of Interest to 10 pages.

Expressions of interest must be delivered in written form to the address below (in person or by e-mail) by 14 August 2026 at 23:45 (local time), referencing: "Expression of Interest – Hiring of a Commercial Director for EMAE – Ref.60/C/ACRE/2026". Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours, from 08:00 to 16:00.

The Punjab Affordable Housing Program (PAHP) is funded by the World Bank. The Urban Unit and the Punjab Housing and Town Planning Agency (PHATA) are the co-implementing agencies for the program. The program will support the Government of Punjab in strengthening its housing institutions and systems and enhance the quantity and quality of affordable housing. The focus will be on promoting private sector participation in affordable housing provision through infrastructure investment support and the public sector's delivery of alternate housing solutions to the poorest; strengthening institutions with critical roles in housing policy and programs; deepening housing sector regulatory reforms; and promoting livability and sustainability of housing through climate resilient and energy efficient infrastructure investments.
